newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz shares jump on upbeat 97 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Allianz shares jump on upbeat 97 forecasts.

text.p: Shares in German insurer Allianz AG rose after it said it expected its premium income to rise 11 percent to around 83 billion marks ($48.7 billion) this year and said it expected moderate double-digit growth in 1997.
The share rose 4.50 marks to a new high of 383.50 marks, a jump of 3.50 marks or around 1.20 percent straight after the announcement, before falling back to 382.20 marks, up 0.80 percent.
The overall IBIS DAX index was up 23.13 points, or 0.63 percent, at 3,688.56 points pre-bourse.
As well as saying that it expected its sales and earnings to improve in 1997, Allianz said it expected underwriting earnings to show a profit for the first time since 1990.
